summary: This bill amends the Social Security Act to require hospitals to establish written policies ensuring patients' rights to receive visitors, including designated family or friends, and prohibits discrimination in visitation privileges based on race, color, national origin, religion, sex, or disability.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Social Security Act to codify patient visitation rights in healthcare institutions, ensuring individuals can receive visitors and preventing discrimination in visitation privileges. This directly impacts the operational aspects and patient experience within the healthcare system, making it central to healthcare policy.
